shared.conditioning_truth_policy: Only selected projected XZ tracks, masks, camera, times and declared domain; no XYZ, hidden Y or target velocity in inference.

observation_selection.training: Dataset-specific selection overrides are mandatory: JHTDB uses a shared epoch-keyed nested permutation after reserving probes; FS uses fixed published nested seed47 particle IDs in every epoch and split.
observation_selection.validation_test: Frozen IDs across methods/seeds; nested N; no target-guided particle selection.

sampling.uncertainty_scope: Descriptive two-draw variation only; no calibrated posterior claim.

shared.boundary_information: No ground-truth boundary velocities in ANY model inputs. All Tensor/DiT known-boundary masks must be empty for BOTH datasets; their final projection is a no-op. FS prescribed/support/material masks are for masked supervision and evaluation, not prescribed-velocity conditioning.

checkpoint_selection.main: Fixed final epoch 100; EMA for applicable learned models. No test selection.
checkpoint_selection.best_checkpoint: Diagnostic only; validation training loss is not generated-field accuracy.

shared.normalization: Training split only; masked on FS. Separate statistics for each dataset. Never reuse LBM statistics or Tucker artifact.

canonical_coordinates.transform: x_cell_i=(x_physical_i-lower_i)*31/(upper_i-lower_i); u_cell_i=u_physical_i*31/(upper_i-lower_i). Time stays in native physical units. Save inverse transform and compute reported errors in original units. Raw releases unchanged.
canonical_coordinates.fs_domain_information: Existing release bounds (union of exported material points over the process) are declared common known-domain side information, not hidden training-fitted statistics; report this provenance.

fitting.pod_rank_policy: Truncate to centered training numerical rank. Build basis once, reuse across N/seeds.
fitting.sigma_policy: Optimization likelihood scale, not asserted measurement noise. Select on validation then freeze; no test tuning.

models.exclusion_reason: Existing steady unforced constant-viscosity NS residual is not justified for either forced turbulent snapshot or thermomechanical SPH. No guessed viscosity.

tensor_space.selection_rule: Smallest rank with validation mean relativeL2<=0.05 and maximum<=0.20; if no candidate passes, stop/review rather than silently accept.

metrics.jhtdb_mask: All fluid native-grid samples; derivative diagnostics exclude crop edges as required by stencil. No prescribed boundary velocity supplied.
metrics.fs_mask: material & interpolation_support & ~prescribed; time-weighted with native times, report coverage.
metrics.fs_independent_metric: Heldout native transport-velocity probe RMSE in m/s
metrics.evaluation_depth: Inference-only hidden initial Y fit for observed tracks; target XYZ never initializes reconstruction. Any full-XYZ evaluation-only probe initialization is explicitly disclosed and isolated. Do not feed extra cameras to inference.
metrics.generative_aggregation: Report mean per-draw field error separately from error of sample-mean field.
metrics.summary: First average cases/windows within each seed, then mean and sample std(ddof=1) across training seeds. FS results remain one-case conditional time extrapolation. Mean has no fake repeated seeds.
metrics.test_policy: Test untouched for horizon, sigma, rank, normalization, checkpoint or architecture selection.

pilot.purpose: Data/geometry/no-leakage checks, finite gradients, memory and timing. No scientific comparison claims.

checks: tiny forward/backward with finite loss and gradients for every enabled learned implementation
one-case POD and RBF fitting smoke, finite output and hidden-depth information isolation
mean train-only statistics and finite predictions
shared selected observations and empty known-boundary inputs
three listed architectures additionally provide resource/timing benchmarks

matrix.note: This is a planned matrix, not submitted jobs. Per-case POD/RBF optimization is distinct from supervised training.

source_policy: Reference implementations locked by SHA256. Required adapter/model changes must produce a new reviewed source snapshot and updated lock before a readiness gate can pass; do not modify the historical production snapshot in place.
